{{Quote|I am Darth Nyriss, Lord of the Sith. I am the conqueror of Drezzi, the destroyer of Melldia, and a member of the Dark Council!|Darth Nyriss|<ref name="Revan">''[[The Old Republic: Revan]]''</ref>}}
'''Melldia''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="Revan" /> located in the [[Melldia system/Legends|Melldia system]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories's]] [[Esstran sector/Legends|Esstran sector]].<ref name="EAOC" /> In [[3950 BBY]], the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Nyriss]] claimed to be "the destroyer of Melldia."<ref name="Revan" />
